bar.text: Free tool: find out what websites can tell about your browser. Spoiler: plenty.

home.heading: Am I a Bot?
home.body: Websites quietly check whether you're a person or a script. Tells runs those same checks in your browser and explains each one in plain words. No sign-up, nothing to install, and it keeps no copy of your results.
home.agents_lead: Building a bot on purpose? Point your script at it and read the JSON.
home.art_alt: Sleeper Cell, the unit's privacy scout, spotting a bot on the radar

compare.heading: Does your current tool look human?
compare.body: Websites check. Run the free Am I a Bot? test in the browser you use it in and see what they see.

agents.heading: Your AI agent swears it's human
agents.body: Websites have opinions. See what they can read about the browser your agent drives, in plain words.

thanks.text: While that downloads: see what websites can tell about your browser. Takes a minute. Free, and slightly unsettling.
